TITLE.LOCALISED_TEXT: カターリの爆（ばく）撃（げき）兵（へい）

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: When Kathari Bomber deals combat damage to a player, put two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens onto the battlefield and sacrifice Kathari Bomber.
Quand le Grenadier kathari inflige des blessures de combat à un joueur, mettez sur le champ de bataille deux jetons de créature 1/1 rouge Gobelin et sacrifiez le Grenadier kathari.
Cuando el Bombardero kathari haga daño de combate a un jugador, pon en el campo de batalla dos fichas de criatura Trasgo rojas 1/1 y sacrifica el Bombardero kathari.
Wenn der Kathari-Bomber einem Spieler Kampfschaden zufügt, bringe zwei 1/1 rote Goblin-Kreaturenspielsteine ins Spiel und opfere den Kathari-Bomber.
Quando il Bombardiere Kathari infligge danno da combattimento a un giocatore, metti sul campo di battaglia due pedine creatura Goblin 1/1 rosse e sacrifica il Bombardiere Kathari.
カターリの爆撃兵がプレイヤー１人に戦闘ダメージを与えたとき、赤の１/１のゴブリン・クリーチャー・トークンを２体場に出し、カターリの爆撃兵を生け贄に捧げる。
카타리 폭탄병이 플레이어에게 전투피해를 입힐 때, 1/1 적색 고블린 생물 토큰 두 개를 전장에 놓고 카타리 폭탄병을 희생한다.
Когда Истребитель Катари наносит боевые повреждения игроку, положите на поле битвы две фишки существа 1/1 красный Гоблин и пожертвуйте Истребителя Катари.
Quando Bombardeiro Kathari causar dano de combate a um jogador, coloque em jogo duas fichas de criatura vermelhas 1/1 do tipo Goblin e sacrifique Bombardeiro Kathari.
当卡刹立轰击师对任一牌手造成战斗伤害时，将两个1/1红色鬼怪衍生生物放进战场，且牺牲卡刹立轰击师。
當卡剎立轟擊師對任一玩家造成戰鬥傷害時，將兩個1/1紅色精靈衍生生物放進戰場，且犧牲卡剎立轟擊師。
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: if EffectSource() ~= nil then EffectController():Sacrifice( EffectSource() ) end

ACTIVATED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local creature = EffectSource() if creature ~= nil then EffectDC():Make_Targets(0):Set_CardPtr(0, creature) EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Protect_CardPtr(0) creature:PutOntoBattlefield( EffectController() ) end

local creature = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if creature ~= nil then local delayDC = EffectDC():Make_Targets(1) delayDC:Set_CardPtr(0, creature)
MTG():CreateDelayedTrigger( 2, delayDC) end

local creature = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if creature ~= nil then local delayDC = EffectDC():Make_Targets(2) delayDC:Set_CardPtr(0, creature)
MTG():CreateDelayedTrigger( 3, delayDC) end
ACTIVATED_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Bool_Set(CHARACTERISTIC_HASTE, 1) end

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:Exile() end

TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TRIGGER: if TriggerObject() == EffectDC():Get_CardPtr(0) and (GetToZone() ~= ZONE_EXILE) then MTG():OverrideEvent() return true else return false end
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: if TriggerObject() ~= nil then TriggerObject():Exile() end
